The in-person transaction in region 205 aligns with the cardholder's established baseline pattern of in-person product W purchases and prior regional spending. Furthermore, the card is not linked to any device fraud ring, and prior high-value model alert CC-5401 was cleared as legitimate. The alert is determined to be a false alarm, and the case is closed as legitimate activity.
